decisions.reason: The vegan superfood drink mix sits far from the firm's waste-to-energy technology core, and there is no evidence of traction since 2019, so this low-information consumer option is best abandoned to free resources for the core technology options.
The modular plant extensions complement the core waste-to-energy offer and cost little to keep as an add-on, so the option is worth holding while demand for decentralized plants remains uncertain.
The waste-oil plant was publicly launched as a flagship decentralized solution, and its long industrial sales cycles mean uncertainty has not yet resolved enough to justify abandoning it.
The plastic-to-fuel plant addresses a large and growing waste problem central to the firm's mission and had gained more website prominence by 2019, making it a high-upside option worth keeping open.
